Title: Ajay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ajay - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Hema - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Karan - 59 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Ajay stands by the well. Hema and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "Hema, what's the plan today?"

[Ajay grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Ajay (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[Ajay churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Hema: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Karan: "Hema, look over here."

[Ajay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Hema: "This is amazing!"

[Ajay and Mother clink their glasses.]

Ajay: "Exactly right."

[Ajay walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Karan: "That's great!"

[Ajay is dying to see the new film.]

Hema: "How beautiful!"

[Ajay laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Ajay: "Dad, are you okay?"

[Ajay jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Ajay: "Show me too!"

[Ajay coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Karan: "I really enjoyed today."
